ExpXml: <Summary><Title>RNA-seq of Drosophila exposed to trametinib under normal and high sugar dietary conditions</Title><Platform instrument_model="Illumina HiSeq 1500">ILLUMINA</Platform><Statistics total_runs="1" total_spots="25682895" total_bases="7704868500" total_size="2492463230" load_done="true" cluster_name="public"/></Summary><Submitter acc="ERA36163770" center_name="European Bioinformatics Institute" contact_name="European Nucleotide Archive" lab_name="European Nucleotide Archive"/><Experiment acc="ERX16565911" ver="1" status="public" name="RNA-seq of Drosophila exposed to trametinib under normal and high sugar dietary conditions"/><Study acc="ERP193087" name="RNA-seq of Drosophila exposed to trametinib under normal and high sugar dietary conditions"/><Organism taxid="7227" ScientificName="Drosophila melanogaster"/><Sample acc="ERS29998344" name=""/><Instrument ILLUMINA="Illumina HiSeq 1500"/><Library_descriptor><LIBRARY_NAME>1x sugar Tram+ A4_p</LIBRARY_NAME><LIBRARY_STRATEGY>RNA-Seq</LIBRARY_STRATEGY><LIBRARY_SOURCE>TRANSCRIPTOMIC</LIBRARY_SOURCE><LIBRARY_SELECTION>PolyA</LIBRARY_SELECTION><LIBRARY_LAYOUT><PAIRED/></LIBRARY_LAYOUT><LIBRARY_CONSTRUCTION_PROTOCOL>Adult flies were reared at standard density on sugar-yeast-agar (SYA) media. Newly eclosed adults were transfered to fresh culture vessels and incubated at 25C for 24h before being sorted by sex. Female flies were transferred to vials (15 flies per vial) and incubated until 10 days of age when they were snap frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at -80C. Flies were maintained on two different diets: normal (1x) sugar or high (8x sugar) with either vehicle alone (DMSO) or 15.6uM trametinib (added from a stock solution of trametinib dissolved in DMSO). Final DMSO concentration was maintained at 0.025%. Total RNA was isolated from whole adult female flies by homogenisation in TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen) according to the manufacturerâ€™s protocol. Following chloroform extraction, RNAs were purified using RNeasy Mini columns (Qiagen) including an on-column DNase digestion. RNA-seq libraries were prepared using a TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep kit (Illumina). Libraries were quantified on a Bioanalyzer (Agilent Technologies).</LIBRARY_CONSTRUCTION_PROTOCOL></Library_descriptor><Bioproject>PRJEB112560</Bioproject><Biosample>SAMEA122408228</Biosample>
